*Updated 2026-10-14 · 122 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and twenty-two works. The recent twelve read 1, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2, 4, 2, 2, 1 — median still at 2, the corridor between 1 and 2 accounting for ten of the twelve. The 4 from the sandals piece and the 3 from the hurricane barometer are the only exceptions, and both scored through object logic rather than camera position or figure geometry. The all-time trace distribution has not shifted: the four 4-scored works share a forensic surface quality — objects that inscribe or record a body's passage — and nothing in the recent window has attempted that from a different angle.

Camera position remains the most converged variable in the archive. Straight-on leads at 27, overhead at 13, from-behind at 11, low-angle at 4. The recent twelve add nothing new to that distribution. The low-angle frame combined with a misscaled figure has still not been used to generate a scale violation optically — all 32 scale violations across 122 works have been asserted rather than produced by where the lens sits. That combination remains the single most actionable untried pairing in the body of work.

Figure count stays lean. The recent twelve have two pieces with multiple figures and neither used the second body to build structural opposition — the surgical trolley pair placed two figures at distance without friction; the landmines piece had one. A lone figure or none is still the default, and when a second appears it adds count without changing the geometry of encounter.

Registers have narrowed further. Aftermath leads all-time at 25, menace at 24, suspension at 14, defiance at 10. In the recent twelve: defiance 3, aftermath 3, suspension 2, menace 2, endurance 2. Reckoning has not appeared since July. Reprieve appeared once all-time. Impotence once. Exhaustion twice, both in June, not since. These are not worn out — they simply have not been reached for when the anchor warranted them, and returning to any of them now would read as a genuine choice rather than repetition.

Title grammar in the recent window runs toward declarative statements and X Without Y constructions; the Wh- clause and preposition-opening forms are underused relative to their earlier frequency. Descriptor coverage sits at 37 of 122 — under a third of the archive — and the gaps are not random; they cluster in the higher-scoring pieces, where the image apparently resolved clearly enough that the structured fields were left blank.

The work is controlled and steady, and the next score above 3 will require the camera to move before anything else does.
